who_may_bargain.value: Any person employed by a local government employer (counties, cities, towns, school districts, charter schools, hospital, irrigation and other special districts), and classified state employees other than managerial and other excluded employees. Local supervisory employees under NRS 288.138(1)(b), doctors and physicians, and certain civil-division attorneys may not be members of an employee organization, and confidential employees are excluded from local bargaining units
who_may_bargain.quote: “Local government employee” means any person employed by a local government employer.

impasse_procedure.value: Local government: mediation, then non-binding fact-finding after April 1 (binding only in the cases in 288.200(5)). School districts and units of teachers or educational support personnel: after at least four negotiation sessions either party may declare impasse and, on 5 days' written notice, submit the remaining issues to an arbitrator (NRS 288.217). Police and firefighters go to final-offer arbitration whose decision is final and binding.
impasse_procedure.quote: either party to the dispute, at any time after April 1, may submit the dispute to an impartial fact finder for the findings and recommendations of the fact finder. The findings and recommendations of the fact finder are not binding on the parties except as provided in subsection 5.

strike_legality.value: Illegal: strikes against the State or any local government employer are illegal and must be enjoined, with fines on organizations and officers (separate penalty provisions apply to teachers' organizations)
strike_legality.quote: 2. The Legislature therefore declares it to be the public policy of the State of Nevada that strikes against the State or any local government employer are illegal.

agency_fee_status.value: Prohibited. Nevada's right-to-work law bars denying employment for nonmembership, and Janus v. AFSCME (2018) bars agency fees from nonconsenting public employees.
agency_fee_status.quote: No person shall be denied the opportunity to obtain or retain employment because of nonmembership in a labor organization, nor shall the State, or any subdivision thereof or any corporation, individual or association of any kind enter into any agreement, written or oral, which excludes any person from employment or continuation of employment because of nonmembership in a labor organization.

dfr_forum.value: Government Employee-Management Relations Board. Interfering with, restraining or coercing an employee in the exercise of chapter rights is a prohibited practice for an employee organization, heard by the board.
dfr_forum.quote: 2. It is a prohibited practice for a local government employee or for an employee organization or its designated agent willfully to: (a) Interfere with, restrain or coerce any employee in the exercise of any right guaranteed under this chapter.
